question: Find Burlington Public Library storytime programs in Burlington, Ontario for my preschooler this October 2026. Check the official pages and give me the published dates, times and prices, with the links.
reply: Burlington Public Library's pages list these October storytimes, all 10:30-11:00am. Prices aren't published on any of them, so I can't say if they're free. Family Storytime at Central Library (Children's Storytime Tree) is for kids 5 and younger. It runs Thu Oct 22, Fri Oct 23, Sat Oct 24 and Fri Oct 30. Link: https://bpl.libnet.info/event/3493126 Music & Rhythm Storytime at the Aldershot Branch (Program Room) runs Wed Oct 21 and Wed Oct 28. The age group is listed as Families / Children Early Years. Link: https://attend.bpl.on.ca/event/993654 Halloween Storytime at the Aldershot Branch (Program Room) runs Tue Oct 27, with the same age group. Link: https://attend.bpl.on.ca/event/993654 Want me to add one of these to your calendar for Maya? https://bpl.libnet.info/event/3493258
